name: How should I prepare my basement before drywall repair work begins?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my basement before drywall repair work begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before a drywall contractor arrives, clear personal belongings, furniture, and storage boxes at least four to six feet away from the damaged wall or ceiling. Basements often function as primary storage areas, so creating a clear pathway from the exterior entryway allows the crew to safely transport drywall sheets, ladders, and compound buckets. If the drywall damage resulted from an active plumbing leak, ensure the underlying leak has been completely repaired and the framing has fully dried out before the repair appointment begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear furniture and stored items away from the work area, create a clear path to the basement, and ensure any active water leaks are fully fixed and dried beforehand.
